title: Block Chest Obstruction
description: This defines how a block reacts to a chest being opened underneath it.

obstruction_rule.title: Obstruction Rule
obstruction_rule.description:
[optional] How the block should be evaluated by a chest during chest opening. Must be one of the following options:
"always" - Will always oba chest from opening when directly above it.
"never" - Will never obstruct a chest from opening when directly above it.
"shape" - Will use the Blocks collision shape to determine if the chest is obstructed from opening when directly above it; this is the default value if no rule is provided.
A Block can define its collision shape by adding a collision component.

Sample values:
• black_concrete_stairs.block: never
